create_Pair: create a Pair dataclass instance with text, hypothesis, id, entailment, and similarity fields
parse_xml_string: parse an ASSIN2 XML string into a list of Pair objects with text, hypothesis, id, entailment, and similarity
get_element_text: extract text content from an XML element by tag name in an ASSIN2 pair
test_parse_xml_string: test parse_xml_string with valid ASSIN2 XML containing entailment and similarity attributes
review_Pair: review the Pair dataclass fields and types used to represent ASSIN2 text-hypothesis pairs
